author: New China TV
description: Egypt has completed an initial public offering of 45 percent of Banque du Caire, raising more than 36.3 billion Egyptian pounds (about 650.7 million U.S. dollars) in the largest-ever offering on the Egyptian Exchange, the government announced Monday.
title: Egypt completes record 650-mln-USD IPO of Banque du Caire

author: New China TV
description:
On Nov. 3, the 9th Silk Road (Dunhuang) International Cultural Expo opened in China's Gansu, drawing over 1,000 guests from 50+ countries and multiple international organizations.
A group of university students and faculty from Oklahoma (USA) has visited the Mogao Caves, a living proof that Dunhuang was a key hub where Eastern and Western civilizations met.
title: From Oklahoma to Dunhuang: American group explores East-West cultural encounters at the Mogao Caves

author: New China TV
description: The captive population of giant pandas in China has reached 830, while the genetic diversity of the population continues to improve, an official said at the ongoing Global Panda Partners 2026 conference on Tuesday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Captive population of giant pandas in China reaches 830

author: New China TV
description: At 6 a.m. Eastern Time (1100 GMT) on Tuesday, Election Day, polling places in several eastern U.S. states, including Maine, New York and Virginia, were among the first to open.
title: Voting begins for U.S. midterms amid concerns over rising living costs

author: New China TV
description: From an ancient vision to modern engineering, China is using precisely controlled water and sediment regulation to tackle sediment buildup in its mother river, the Yellow River. Through 33 coordinated reservoir operations, the average riverbed elevation of the main channel in the lower reaches has been reduced by 3.1 meters, helping improve the river's long-term health and flood prevention.
title: From ancient wisdom to modern engineering: How China manages the Yellow River

author: New China TV
description: "Dunhuang brings together so many different fields." Once a bustling Silk Road hub, Dunhuang continues to connect cultures. At the 9th Silk Road (Dunhuang) International Cultural Expo in northwest China, scholars from around the world came together to explore its rich heritage and exchange ideas across cultures.
title: Dunhuang cultural expo promotes inter-civilizational dialogue

title: New China TV: Discover more about China

author: New China TV
description:
"I'm coming. Just... very slowly." 
A visitor filmed one turtle helping another back onto its feet at Hongshan Forest Zoo in Nanjing, China.
Sometimes, a little help takes a little longer to arrive. 
Tag a friend who always shows up for you.
title: Sometimes, a little help takes a little longer to arrive

author: New China TV
description:
A terrifying moment unfolded along the Qiantang River when a man fishing by the riverbank was swept away by a powerful tidal bore. Fortunately, he managed to swim toward shallow water and escape unharmed.
A moment of luck is no substitute for safety. Stay away from dangerous waters and never take chances with your life.
title: Close call! Angler swept away by Qiantang River tidal bore, escapes to safety

author: New China TV
description:
Two cities. Two gardens. One enduring friendship.
At Ningbo's Sino-French Friendship Garden, Joachim Moyse, a delegate to the 2026 Global Mayors Dialogue, shares the story of the bond between Ningbo and Rouen that has grown for more than three decades.
#Ningbo #Rouen #GMD2026 #GlobalMayorsDialogue
title: Trendy China | Inside Ningbo's Sino-French Friendship Garden

description: The first World Robot Mount Tai Climbing Competition was held in Tai'an, Shandong on Nov. 2, bringing together nearly 90 teams to compete along Mount Tai's historic hiking trails. Humanoid, quadruped and wheel-legged bots fought for glory at this one-of-a-kind climbing contest.
title: Mechanical hikers arrive on Mount Tai

title: Farmer frustration tests Republicans' rural edge ahead of midterms

description: The Grand Egyptian Museum has marked the first anniversary of its official opening. Follow us for a closer look at its artifacts. (recorded)

description: More than 3,100 stone steps, steep slopes and rain-slicked paths: China's robots are taking on Mount Tai in the world's first robot climbing competition. From humanoid and quadruped robots to load-carrying machines and wearable exoskeletons, the challenge puts cutting-edge robotics to the test on real-world terrain, exploring their potential for applications in logistics, disaster response and beyond.
